$comment: Golden NCR trips for phase-1 acceptance (spec §3 criterion 3). Corridors and minima were chosen against the live router on 2026-11-01, re-probed after the alias-aware republish (494-route feed), and every value below is the count/mode/fare the live stack actually returns at the pinned departure; see docs/runbooks/phase1-acceptance.md for the probe evidence, per-trip counts and every R10 data reason. `minItineraries` is never the brief's illustrative 3 where the data cannot meet it. `requiredModes` must appear in the union of the trip's itineraries (the corridor must offer the mode), not in every itinerary. `fareBounds` are the live observed min/max rounded outward; they catch a broken fare engine without pinning exact prices.

trips.name: Cubao to Ayala
trips.note: MRT-3 corridor (Cubao -> Ayala); live run returned 10 itineraries, 4 of them MRT-3.

trips.name: Fairview to Makati
trips.note: Fairview -> UV Express -> MRT-3 -> Makati after the curated UV routes entered the feed; live run returned 10 itineraries. The brief's illustrative jeepney+bus expectation does not hold on this data (no jeepney leg on this corridor).

trips.name: Novaliches to Ortigas
trips.note: Camanava/Quirino Highway corridor; live run returned 4 jeepney+bus itineraries at PHP 97.20.

trips.name: Pasig to Manila
trips.note: Pasig River Ferry corridor; all 5 live itineraries were walk+ferry. Fare is 0 because the MMDA ferry is free (data/fares/fares-2026-09-28.yaml).

trips.name: Marikina to Cubao
trips.note: LRT-2 corridor; live run returned 12 itineraries, 4 with LRT-2.

trips.name: Las Pinas to Makati
trips.note: South corridor with LRT-1, UV Express and bus options; live run returned 19 itineraries.

trips.name: Quezon Avenue to BGC
trips.note: Quezon Avenue -> MRT-3 -> BGC bus; live run returned 7 itineraries.

trips.name: Bagong Silang to Novaliches
trips.note: The strongest jeepney corridor (curated T101's corridor, modelled by OSM share_taxi geometry); live run returned 8 itineraries, all with jeepney.

trips.name: Balintawak to Novaliches
trips.note: Curated T165's corridor (Balintawak Cloverleaf -> Novaliches via Quirino Highway); after the aliases entered the feed the live router returns 5 jeepney itineraries at PHP 22.39.

trips.name: Cubao to Divisoria
trips.note: Short heavy city corridor used for the R37 keep-alive stress loop as well; live run returned 4 bus itineraries.
